H2500.def: from «02498»; properly, exchange; hence (as preposition) instead of:--X for.

H2501.def: the same as «02500»; change; Cheleph, a place in Palestine:--Heleph.

H2502.def: a primitive root; to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen:--arm (self), (go, ready) armed (X man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.

H2503.def: or Chelets {khay'-lets; from «02502»; perhaps, strength; Chelets, the name of two Israelites:--Helez.

H2504.def: from «02502» (in the sense of strength); only in the dual; the loins (as the seat of vigor):--loins, reins.

H2505.def: a primitive root; to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate:--deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-)part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).

H2506.def: from «02505»; properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment:--flattery, inheritance, part, × partake, portion.

H2507.def: the same as «02506»; portion; Chelek, an Israelite:--Helek.

H2508.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02505»; a part:--portion.

H2510.def: the same as «02509»; bare; Chalak, a mountain of Idumaea:--Halak.

H2513.def: feminine of «02506»; properly, smoothness; figuratively, flattery; also an allotment:--field, flattering(-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land (ground), plat, portion, slippery place, smooth (thing).

H2516.def: patronymically from «02507»; a Chelkite or descendant of Chelek:--Helkites.

H2518.def: or Chilqiyahuw {khil-kee-yaw'-hoo}'from «02506» and «03050»; portion of Jah; {Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites:-- Hillkiah.

H2519.def: by reduplication from «02505»; properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment:--flattery, slippery.

H2520.def: a form of «02513»; smoothness; Chelkath, a place in Palestine:--Helkath.

H2521.et: from (02520) and the pl. of (06697), with the article inserted
H2521.def: from «02520» and the plural of «06697», with the article inserted; smoothness of the rocks; Chelkath Hats-tsurim, a place in Palestine:--Helkath-hazzurim.

H2522.def: a primitive root; to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay:--discomfit, waste away, weaken.

H2524.def: from the same as «02346»; a father-in-law (as in affinity):--father in law.

H2526.def: the same as «02525»; hot (from the tropical habitat); Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country:--Ham.

H2529.def: or (shortened) chemah {khay-maw'}; from the same root as «02346»; curdled milk or cheese:--butter.

H2530.def: a primitive root; to delight in:--beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, (X great) delight, desire, goodly, lust, (be) pleasant (thing), precious (thing).

H2532.def: feminine of «02531»; delight:--desire, goodly, pleasant, precious.

H2534.def: or (Dan. 11:44) chemaC {khay-maw'}; from «03179»; heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever):--anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(- ful). See «02529».

H2535.def: from «02525»; heat; by implication, the sun:--heat, sun.

H2536.def: from «02535» and «0410»; anger of God; Chammuel, an Israelite:--Hamuel.

H2537.def: or Chamiytal {kham-ee-tal'}; from «02524» and «02919»; father-in-law of dew; Chamutal or Chamital, an Israelitess:-- Hamutal.

H2539.def: patronymically from «02538»: a Chamulite (collectively) or descendants of Chamul:--Hamulites.

H2540.def: from «02552»; warm spring; Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine:--Hammon.

H2541.def: from «02556»; properly, violent; by implication, a robber:--oppressed.

H2543.def: or (shortened) chamor {kham-ore}; from «02560»; a male ass (from its dun red):--(he)ass.

H2544.def: the same as «02543»; donkey; Chamor, a Canaanite:--Hamor.

H2545.def: or (shortened) chamoth {kham-oth'}; feminine of «02524»; a mother-in-law:--mother in law.

H2546.et: from an unused root probably meaning, to lie low
H2546.def: from an unused root probably meaning, to lie low; a lizard (as creeping):--snail.

H2547.def: feminine of «02546»; low; Chumtah, a place in Palestine:--Humtah.

H2549.def: or chamishshiy {kham-ish-shee'}; ord. from «02568»; fifth; also a fifth:--fifth (part).

H2550.def: a primitive root; to commiserate; by implication, to spare:--have compassion, (have) pity, spare.

H2552.def: a primitive root; to be hot (literally or figuratively):--enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at).

H2554.def: a primitive root; to be violent; by implication, to maltreat:--make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.

H2555.def: from «02554»; violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain:--cruel(-ty), damage, false, injustice, × oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.

H2556.def: a primitive root; to be pungent; i.e. in taste (sour, i.e. literally fermented, or figuratively, harsh), in color (dazzling):--cruel (man), dyed, be grieved, leavened.

H2559.def: a primitive root; properly, to wrap; hence, to depart (i.e. turn about):--go about, withdraw self.

H2560.def: a primitive root; properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); as denominative (from «02564») to smear with pitch:--daub, befoul, be red, trouble.

H2561.def: from «02560»; wine (as fermenting):--X pure, red wine.

H2563.def: from «02560»; properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure:--clay, heap, homer, mire, motion.

H2564.def: from «02560»; bitumen (as rising to the surface):--slime(-pit).

H2567.def: a denominative from «02568»; to tax a fifth:--take up the fifth participle

H2568.def: masculine chamishshah {kham-ish-shaw}; a primitive numeral; five:--fif(-teen), fifth, five (X apiece).

H2570.et: from an unused root probably meaning, to be stout
H2570.def: from an unused root probably meaning, to be stout; the abdomen (as obese):--fifth (rib).

H2571.et: pass. participle of the same as (02570)
H2571.def: passive participle of the same as «02570»; staunch, i.e. able-bodied soldiers:--armed (men), harnessed.

H2573.def: from the same as «02346»; a skin bottle (as tied up):--bottle.

H2574.def: from the same as «02346»; walled; Chamath, a place in Syria:--Hamath, Hemath.

H2575.et: a variation for the first part of (02576)
H2575.def: a variation for the first part of «02576»; hot springs; Chammath, a place in Palestine:--Hammath.

H2576.def: from the plural of «02535» and «01756»; hot springs of Dor; Chammath-Dor, a place in Palestine:--Hamath-Dor.

H2577.def: patrial from «02574»; a Chamathite or native of Chamath:--Hamathite.

H2578.def: from «02574» and «06678»; Chamath of Tsobah; Chamath-Tsobah; probably the same as «02574»:--Hamath-Zobah.

H2579.def: from «02574» and «07237»; Chamath of Rabbah; Chamath-Rabbah, probably the same as «02574».

H2580.def: from «02603»; graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty):--favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-)favoured.

H2581.def: the same as «02580»; grace; Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite:--Hen.

H2582.def: probably from «02580» and «0l908»; favor of Hadad; Chenadad, an Israelite:--Henadad.

H2583.def: a primitive root (compare «02603»); properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch a tent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege):--abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

H2585.def: from «02596»; initiated; Chanok, an antediluvian patriach:--Enoch.

H2586.def: from «02603»; favored; Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites:--Hanun.

H2588.def: from «02583»; properly, a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication, a prison:--cabin.

H2589.def: from «02603» (in the sense of prayer); supplication:--be gracious, intreated.

H2590.def: a primitive root; to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen:--embalm, put forth.

H2592.def: from «02603» and «0410»; favor of God; Channiel, the name of two Israelites:--Hanniel.

H2595.def: from «02583»; a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent):--javelin, spear.

H2596.def: a primitive root; properly, to narrow (compare «02614»); figuratively, to initiate or discipline:--dedicate, train up.

H2599.def: patronymically from «02585»; a Chanokite (collectively) or descendants of Chanok:--Hanochites.
